reviewer: Codex source adjudication for founder-requested GameStop batch recovery

source_artifacts.format: Preserved actual web-tool source extraction JSON; not original HTML.
source_artifacts.fact: Contemporaneous PokeBeach report explicitly names a Reverse Holo GameStop Charmander. Independent Fanatics physical slab photograph shows the red GameStop stamp,MEW004/165,70HP and large Fire Energy geometric reverse pattern across the text body; no Cosmos circles/stars. This resolves the conflicting later Bulbapedia Cosmos Parallel and TCGdex-derived Normal labels in favor of Reverse. Fanatics title incorrectly says Sword & Shield; photographed MEW label and card establish exact set.
Exact product identity; raw prices and generic Holofoil bucket do not authorize any additional finish.
